Class MouseDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a mouse input device, providing access to mouse buttons, axes, and wheel axes, as well as state tracking and utility methods for mouse input.

public sealed class MouseDevice : InputDevice, IComparable<InputDevice>

DeviceProcessPriority

The process priority of this mouse device instance.

Change this value to change the order in which this device is processed in InputSystem. Lower priorities are processed first. 

public uint DeviceProcessPriority

uint

Remarks

A unique value based on the order of instantiation is assigned per default.

CreateInputState(ShapeMouseAxis, InputState, float, ModifierKeySet?)

Creates an InputState for the specified mouse axis, using the current axis value, a deadzone threshold, an optional modifier key set, and the previous input state to base the new state on.

public InputState CreateInputState(ShapeMouseAxis axis, InputState previousState, float deadzone = 25, ModifierKeySet? modifierKeySet = null)

Parameters

axis ShapeMouseAxis

The mouse axis to evaluate (horizontal or vertical).

previousState InputState

The previous input state to base the new state on.

deadzone float

The minimum movement required to register as "down" (default is the configured move threshold).

modifierKeySet ModifierKeySet

Optional modifier key set that must be active for the axis to be considered "down".

Returns

InputState

An InputState representing the current state of the axis, including whether it is down, up, and its value, based on the previous state.

GetValue(ShapeMouseAxis, Vector2, float, ModifierKeySet?)

Gets the value of the specified mouse axis (horizontal or vertical) based on the difference between the current mouse position and a target position, applying a threshold and optional modifier key set. Returns 0 if the device is locked, the mouse is not on screen, or the modifier key set is not active.

public float GetValue(ShapeMouseAxis axis, Vector2 targetPosition, float threshold, ModifierKeySet? modifierKeySet = null)

Parameters

axis ShapeMouseAxis

The mouse axis to query (horizontal or vertical).

targetPosition Vector2

The position to compare the current mouse position against.

threshold float

The minimum movement required to register a value.

modifierKeySet ModifierKeySet

Optional modifier key set that must be active for the value to be returned.

Returns

float

The axis value, or 0 if below the threshold or input is not valid.

GetValue(ShapeMouseAxis, float, ModifierKeySet?)

Gets the value of the specified mouse axis (horizontal or vertical) based on the current mouse delta, applying a deadzone threshold and optional modifier key set. Returns 0 if the device is locked, the mouse is not on screen, or the modifier key set is not active.

GetValue(ShapeMouseButton, ShapeMouseButton, float, float, ModifierKeySet?)

GetValue(ShapeMouseButton, float, float, ModifierKeySet?)

Gets the value of the specified mouse button, mouse wheel, or mouse axis button. Returns 1 for pressed buttons, or the axis/wheel value if applicable, otherwise 0. Returns 0 if the device is locked, the mouse is not on screen, or the modifier key set is not active.
